name: ESAB Migmatic 250 Three-Phase MIG/MAG Welding Machine
shortDescription: Industrial 250A 3-phase MIG/MAG welding machine with separate wire feeder, 10-step voltage control, and dual digital meters for medium-to-heavy structural fabrication.
overview: The ESAB Migmatic 250 is an industry-standard three-phase MIG/MAG welding system engineered for high-duty fabrication, automotive chassis production, and structural engineering workshops. Powered by a heavy-duty copper-wound step transformer delivering up to 250A @ 60% duty cycle, this machine delivers an exceptionally stable, low-spatter arc on mild steel, stainless steel, and aluminium. It includes a rugged external 2-roll wire feeder unit with a 5-meter interconnection cable, giving the operator maximum reach across large assemblies. Built-in spot and stitch welding timers, 2T/4T trigger latching, and digital parameter displays ensure high process repeatability and ease of use.
keyFeatures: Three-phase 415V power source delivering 40A to 250A output current
60% duty cycle at maximum 250A and 100% duty cycle at 190A continuous rating
Separate lightweight 2-roll wire feeder with stepless speed control (1.5 - 22 m/min)
10-step single knob voltage selector for precise arc voltage optimization
Integrated Spot Welding and Stitch Welding modes with 2T/4T latching controls
Dual digital Volt and Ampere meters for exact parameter compliance
Heavy-duty forced air cooling with automatic thermal overload protection
Industrial undercarriage with heavy rubber wheels and rear gas cylinder rack
applications: Structural steel fabrication and PEB warehouses
Automotive chassis, tipper, and bus body fabrication
Storage tanks, pressure pipes, and heavy steel furniture
Agricultural machinery repair and plant maintenance
packageContents: ESAB PSF 250 MIG Torch (3m Euro Connection)
3-meter Earth Return Cable with 300A Ground Clamp
specsSummary: Mains Supply: 415 V ± 10%, 3-Phase, 50/60 Hz | Welding Current Range: 40 A – 250 A
